evidence: Official bpy Python API reference: every editor/operator/data type is scriptable via bpy, the same interpreter an agent can invoke remotely or in scripts.
Manual documents -b/--background for UI-less operation plus -P/--python, --python-expr and --python-text to run scripts headlessly; -c/--command implies background mode.
Official 'Blender as a Python module' wheel (GPL-3.0): pip install bpy lets an agent import bpy in plain CPython with no Blender process or display needed.
BlenderMCP (formerly blender-mcp): Blender addon opens a socket server plus a Python MCP server (uvx mcp-for-blender) letting LLM clients create/modify objects and run arbitrary Python in Blender.
Official docs cover --headless, --script (run a GDScript without editor), --editor --quit and CLI project export, enabling full headless automation.
Open-source MCP server for Godot 4: Node.js stdio server bridges over WebSocket to a GDScript editor plugin exposing ~173 handlers including execute_editor_script and scene manipulation.
Core Usd API manual for authoring/composing/reading USD stages; all C++ API surfaces have Python bindings under the pxr namespace for scripting.
Gaffer ships a full Python scripting API; .gfr node-graph files are themselves serialized Python, and the embedded Python Editor executes arbitrary graph code.
PyMeshLab exposes MeshLab's filters via Python (MeshSet, apply_filter, load/save), so agents script mesh processing entirely in Python without the MeshLab GUI.
Documents openscad CLI flags: -o exports stl/off/3mf/png without GUI, -D pre-defines variables, -p/-P customizer parameter files; trivially driven by subprocess.
Headless page documents FreeCAD -c / FreeCADCmd console mode launching a full Python interpreter with Part/BIM/Draft APIs, runnable from shell scripts for CI automation.
Pure-Python parametric CAD API (Workplane fluent API, cq.exporters) requiring no GUI; ideal library for agent-authored 3D models exported to STEP/STL/3MF.
Python library for loading/processing/exporting triangular meshes and scenes (import trimesh; scene.export) entirely in-process, no external app needed.
pip-installable open3d package with Python API for geometry/pipelines plus an open3d example CLI; documented headless usage for point clouds and meshes.
makehuman-mcp vendors MakeHuman source behind a GUI-free headless shim (mhcore) and ships an MCP console script, so agents build/export characters with no MakeHuman app running.
Official CLI reference: ns-process-data, ns-train (e.g. splatfacto), ns-render, ns-export expose the full NeRF/splat pipeline as scriptable shell commands.
gsplat provides Python bindings for CUDA-accelerated Gaussian-splat rasterization (pip install gsplat) plus documented simple_trainer.py CLI for end-to-end training.
ComfyUI runs as an aiohttp server: POST JSON workflows to /prompt, stream progress/output over /ws WebSocket, fetch results via /history; fully programmatic, no browser.
Curated awesome-list of real MCP server repos; indexes 3D-relevant servers (Blender, Godot, FreeCAD, Unity, Unreal) usable for agent-driven 3D pipelines.
freecad-mcp pairs an in-FreeCAD addon (XML-RPC server started from toolbar) with a uvx MCP server so Claude agents create/edit objects and execute Python in FreeCAD.
Blender is GPL-3.0-or-later, but the license page states output (images, movies, exported assets) is the user's sole property and not covered by GPL.
FSF GPL FAQ: a program's output is generally not covered by the program's GPL unless the program copies part of itself into the output; basis for freely using Blender/GPL-tool output.

LICENSE.txt is the Tomorrow Open Source Technology License 1.0, a rename of the previous modified Apache-2.0 with identical terms (permissive, only Section 6 trademarks differs from stock Apache-2.0).
Gaffer source is BSD-3-Clause (John Haddon/Image Engine/Cinesite), permitting free use, modification and redistribution in commercial or self-contained tooling.
COPYING is GNU GPL v2; source headers state GPLv2-or-later with a special CGAL linking exception; generated STL/model output is not affected.
ComfyUI core is GPL-3.0; free to run self-hosted, but distributing modified/derived code triggers copyleft.
Stability AI Community License: free research, non-commercial and commercial use only for entities under US$1M annual revenue; above that an Enterprise License is required.
Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.0 Community License: royalty-free but does NOT apply in EU/UK/South Korea, includes an Acceptable Use Policy, and >100M MAU requires a separate Tencent license.
